mr-grinding-mill.name: MR Series Grinding Mill
mr-grinding-mill.short: High-efficiency, low-energy fine powder mill for many materials.
mr-grinding-mill.intro: The MR Series Grinding Mill is Mingrun's high-efficiency, energy-saving powder making machine for non-metallic minerals in metallurgy, mining, building materials, power and chemical industries. It produces ground calcium carbonate, desulfurization limestone powder, coal powder, petroleum coke powder and more.
mr-grinding-mill.principle: After crushing, material is lifted to the hopper and fed evenly and continuously into the grinding chamber. Ground powder is carried by the airflow to the classifier; qualified fine powder is separated in the cyclone collector, while oversize particles fall back into the mill for regrinding. The airflow system works in a closed circuit for a clean working environment.

sf-sand-making-machine.name: SF Series Sand Making Machine
sf-sand-making-machine.short: Vertical impact sand maker for sand making, shaping and powder collection.
sf-sand-making-machine.intro: The SF Series is a vertical impact sand making machine designed mainly for sand production, with powder collection as a secondary function. It is used for natural colored sand, manufactured sand and aggregate shaping, and usually works with a crusher, elevator, belt feeder, vibrating screen and dust collector as a complete sand making line.
sf-sand-making-machine.principle: Feed is split into two streams by the distributor. One stream is accelerated by the high-speed rotor and thrown out to collide with the other stream. In the vortex chamber the material is crushed by repeated impact, friction and grinding before discharging from the bottom. Because crushing happens mostly rock-on-rock, metal wear and contamination are greatly reduced, and internal air circulation keeps dust down.

automatic-packing-palletizing-line.name: Automatic Packing & Palletizing Line
automatic-packing-palletizing-line.short: Fully automatic weighing, bagging and palletizing for powders and granules.
automatic-packing-palletizing-line.intro: The line combines an automatic bag placer, packing machine, conveyors, check weigher, inkjet coder, palletizing robot, pallet magazine, pallet shaper and stretch wrapper. It runs the whole process from bag placing, weighing and filling to palletizing and wrapping without operators, for both valve bags and open-mouth bags.
automatic-packing-palletizing-line.principle: Empty bags are placed automatically and filled to the set weight, then conveyed to the check weigher where off-weight bags are rejected. Accepted bags are coded and stacked by the robot in the selected pattern; full pallets are shaped, wrapped and discharged.

square-tumbler-screen.name: Square Tumbler Screen (MRFX)
square-tumbler-screen.short: High-capacity reciprocating screen that mimics manual sieving.
square-tumbler-screen.intro: The MRFX square tumbler screen (gyratory reciprocating screen) imitates manual sieving. An eccentric drive rotating around a fixed axis produces a regularly changing reciprocating inertial force, giving high throughput, a fully enclosed design and long screen life.
square-tumbler-screen.principle: Driven by the inertial force, the screen box moves back and forth and the screen surface swings periodically, so material advances in directional hops. Particles smaller than the mesh pass to the lower deck as undersize; larger particles discharge from the deck as oversize.

features.title: High capacity
features.text: Multi-deck design that can run as two groups, replacing several machines.

features.title: Gentle, accurate screening
features.text: Combines circular, elliptical and linear motion; acceleration 4–5 times lower than ordinary vibrating screens.

features.title: Stable operation
features.text: Reinforced base, with an optional suspended design for retrofits.

features.title: Easy maintenance
features.text: Screen panel system for quick cleaning and mesh changes.

square-tumbler-screen.applications: Sand and gravel, plastic pellets, metallurgical powders, wood, pharmaceuticals, fertilizers
square-tumbler-screen.materials: Sand and gravel, plastic pellets, metal powders, wood chips, tablets and granules, fertilizers

round-tumbler-screen.name: Round Tumbler Screen (MRYX)
round-tumbler-screen.short: High-precision fine powder screening with 90–95% accuracy.
round-tumbler-screen.intro: The MRYX round tumbler screen is built for high-capacity, high-precision classification. It reproduces the motion of hand sieving mechanically and is ideal for fine powders, micro-particles and difficult materials. Screening accuracy, efficiency and mesh life can reach 5–10 times those of a conventional round vibrating screen.
round-tumbler-screen.principle: A gyratory tumbling motion imitates hand sieving. Material rolls across the screen and spreads evenly toward the edge; fine particles gradually pass through the mesh while coarse particles move to the outlet. Amplitude and frequency are adjustable, and residence time is controlled by the radial and tangential inclination.

features.text: Screening accuracy of 90–95%.

features.title: Multiple mesh cleaning options

features.title: Gentle screening

round-tumbler-screen.applications: Mining, metallurgy, plastics, rubber, fertilizers, spices, recycling
round-tumbler-screen.materials: Fine powders, micro-particles and hard-to-screen materials

linear-vibrating-screen.name: Linear Vibrating Screen (MRZX)
linear-vibrating-screen.short: Low-energy, high-output, fully enclosed linear screen.
linear-vibrating-screen.intro: The MRZX linear vibrating screen uses vibration motors as its excitation source, making material hop forward in a straight line over the mesh and separating it into several sizes across multiple decks. It offers low energy use, high output, a simple structure, easy maintenance and a fully enclosed, dust-free design for automated production lines.
linear-vibrating-screen.principle: Two vibration motors rotate synchronously in opposite directions. The forces of their eccentric weights cancel parallel to the motor axis and combine perpendicular to it, producing straight-line motion. With the motors inclined to the screen deck, material moves forward in hops under this force and its own weight, and is classified by size.
